title: iPhone Apple Music plays sound in Safari
acceptance: On the identified production bundle, Steven hears Apple Music in iPhone Safari Live, then verifies pause, resume, seek, and track advance.
Record device/browser, bundle and Worker, audible outcome, and any exact failure. UI or SDK success alone does not pass.
nextAction: RF-124 is deployed (2026-10-29, SPA index-Cqjj6m_w.js). Run one normal class in iPhone Safari Live on 5G and on Wi-Fi with Web Inspector attached: first reload once (the new bundle clears the stored FairPlay flag) and note the bundle hash, then record the audible outcome of Start (and its delay, RF-128), Pause/Resume, Next, a seek and auto-advance. If anything hangs or shows a banner, capture the console and the exact banner text. Do not implement or deploy from this task.
blocker: Waiting on the RF-124 deploy (PR #657): on production, iPhone plays only the first song.

evidence.summary: Original board entry; historical assertion, not independently verified product behavior.
Failure and owner retry boundary; not a fresh device verification in this migration.
AUD-002: the probe calls requestMediaKeySystemAccess unbound, so the previous next action rested on a false premise. Confirmed in real Chromium by the audit; not on iPhone.

2026-10-28 owner retry on Worker d092af3c-114f-416f-bbe5-cb112cb52306 / assets/index-BTdVQWvK.js (RF-107 deployed): banner 'Apple Music playback failed for "Break Stuff". modern-access: ok.', no audio, clock 0:00. FairPlay access is available; Web Inspector showed the CSP media-src refusal of aod-ssl.itunes.apple.com (RF-122). Console: 'Refused to load https://aod-ssl.itunes.apple.com/.../mzaf_A1440754477...m3u8 because it does not appear in the media-src directive of the Content Security Policy', then MusicKit mediaPlaybackError MEDIA_PLAYBACK 'Playback Error'. setQueue for song 1440754477 timed out (20 s, twice) without an emulated user gesture and resolved in 313 ms with one.

Owner iPhone Safari, 5G, Worker b41b99f9 (RF-122 live), screen recording 23:06: Start class played Break Stuff after about 5 s. Pause worked. Resume stuck on 'Waiting for music — Provider playback has not confirmed progress'. Next to Rollin' (Air Raid Vehicle) showed 'Playback stopped' with Playback error at class clock 2:47.

Owner iPhone Safari (iOS 27.0.1), Wi-Fi, bundle index-BTdVQWvK.js, Worker b41b99f9, Web Inspector probe 09:24-09:56. With mk-safari-modern-eme=1 (set by Ritmo): first song plays and un-pause works, but every later song load (setQueue, skipToNextItem, changeToMediaAtIndex, natural end of a 2-song queue, and a real tap on an injected button) resolved or aborted with MusicKit stopped and no item. With the flag removed and blocked before MusicKit loaded: Ritmo's own Start, Next (Rollin' played), Pause/Resume and auto-advance (track 2 start → advancing) all played on production code.
Deployed 2026-10-29: Worker 2a302ce6-7665-47d2-8f79-68d6822450b1 at main d81c0fc, SPA assets/index-Cqjj6m_w.js; rollback b41b99f9. Smoke and headers passed; tail watch and authed smoke not done.
